name: Lin Hung
bio: Lin Hung is dated by Giles to the 12th century AD. His poem here is a mountain brook seen as a figure of time.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: A Mountain Brook
poems.author: Lin Hung
poems.text:
One draught for my poetic soul I take,
Unconscious river, ere thou slid'st away
To serve the orgies of the Western Lake,
And be no more the pure stream of today.
